{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure fresh state
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Number of SEVERE patients: {len(severe_patients)}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_severe}')"}
